title: Incorrect sanitization of received data during zone AXFR to Bind backend can cause wrong or invalid… (CVE-2026-123764)
description: CVE-2026-123764 is a vulnerability in Bind where incorrect sanitization of data received during zone AXFR transfers to the Bind backend can lead to wrong or invalid data serialization. This flaw has a high severity rating with a CVSS score of 7.5, indicating a significant impact on confidentiality and integrity. No affected versions or patches are specified in the available data.
